sources_used.source: Google Maps (real browser; ~30 category searches for South River NJ 08882, results filtered to the borough boundary polygon)
NJ Business Directory - South River listings
NJTGO South River Business & Shopping guide
Nominatim / OpenStreetMap geocoder and South River boundary polygon (OSM relation 170540), used to confirm which side of the borough line an address is on
U.S. Industry - South River, NJ company list
South River Borough official resource directory

categories_thin: Pest control - a dozen nearby firms serve South River but none is based in the borough
Security system / CCTV installers - all results based in East Brunswick, Sayreville or Old Bridge
Appliance repair - all results outside the borough
Tutoring/test prep and driving schools - none based in South River; residents use East Brunswick providers
Hotels/motels - none inside the borough; the nearest are East Brunswick properties branded 'South River'
General retail - no independent bike shop, music-instrument shop or gift shop in town; retail is florists, jewelry, hardware and auto parts
Pool service - only one plausible local firm (Aquatic Service Inc) and its Maps pin sits outside the borough line
Child care - essentially one large center (Kinder Kastle); the rest of the town's early-childhood capacity is in-district public school
caveats: Many 'contractor' entries are owner-operators using a home address; a street address does not imply a storefront or staffed office.

Businesses were filtered against the South River borough boundary polygon (OSM relation 170540) rather than a 'South River NJ' search radius, so East Brunswick, Sayreville and Old Bridge firms Google surfaces nearby are excluded.

Some Maps pins sit a few hundred metres outside the polygon while the postal address is inside South River (e.g. Big River Lawn at 21 Tice Ave); those were kept with a note. Addresses such as 323 Old Bridge Tpke that look local geocode to East Brunswick and were excluded.

Chains and franchises seen and deliberately excluded: Extra Space Storage, Public Storage, SERVPRO of East Brunswick, The Maids, FASTSIGNS, Floor & Decor, HomeGoods, PetSmart, Guitar Center, Advance Auto Parts, AutoZone, Mavis Discount Tire, Mr. Tire, Leslie's Pool Supplies, Huntington/Kumon/C2 Education, Right At School.

Excluded by rule: restaurants and food service, groceries/liquor/convenience stores (Krauszer's, Stop N Go), pharmacy, banks, public schools, and very large national operations such as the Kellogg's Snacks site and Miller Pipeline Corp on Whitehead Ave.
Two entry pairs are merged duplicates that still appear as separate Google Maps listings (Trygar's/Keys That Please, LD Studio/Lovely Daze, S.R./Dunk N Wash); they are one row each with a note.
data_gaps: South River borough's Resource Directory (southrivernj.org/businessdirectoryii.aspx) returned 'no results' for every query - the module appears unpopulated.
YellowPages, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, BBB and WhereOrg were blocked (403 / Cloudflare / cookie wall) from this environment, so those bulk directories could not be mined.
Overpass API (OpenStreetMap POIs) timed out repeatedly; OSM business data for the borough was not available.
Google Maps returns roughly 11 results per query and ranks by proximity, so a business with a weak Maps presence could still be missing. No Maps API key was available for an exhaustive harvest.

Phone numbers for the dry cleaners, laundromats, Reldan Metals, Westwood Products, Direct Fastening, CVS Service Equipment, Envichem and A-1 Specialized were not published on any listing I could open; marked Unknown.
Websites are recorded only where a listing or search result actually displayed the URL; most entries are blank for the triage team to look up.
